description: In this course, students travel to Riga, Latvia. There they engage with the current and past
issues of immigration, displacement and diaspora, and language politics in Latvia and the Baltic
States more generally. The course centers community engagement: students divide into groups and
collaborate with local community partners according to their interest in either community
building, writing and media in exile, global LGBTQ+ support or environmental sustainability.
fullname: Civic Engagement in Riga, Latvia: Hist, Cult & Politics (study abroad)
